# cod-astro/theme01/src/pages/thank-you.astro

```astro
---
import StoreLayout from "@/theme/layouts/StoreLayout.astro";
import { getStoreContext } from "@/theme/config/store";
import { Icon } from "astro-icon/components";

const { config, content, isRTL } = await getStoreContext();

const orderNumber = Astro.url.searchParams.get("order") ?? "";
const orderId = Astro.url.searchParams.get("oid") ?? "";
const total = Astro.url.searchParams.get("total");
const totalFormatted = total
  ? parseInt(total).toLocaleString("ar-DZ")
  : null;

if (!orderNumber) {
  return Astro.redirect("/");
}

const pixelId = config.pixelId ?? null;
// At checkout stage, only "Purchase" (instant mode) and "Lead" (lead mode) fire on the thank-you page.
// "Purchase_Confirmed" and "Purchase_Delivered" deliberately fire downstream via server CAPI only.
const rawMode = config.conversionEvent ?? "Purchase";
const checkoutEvent =
  rawMode === "Purchase"
    ? "Purchase"
    : rawMode === "Lead"
      ? "Lead"
      : null;
const totalNum = total ? parseInt(total) : null;

const steps = [
  { icon: "heroicons:phone", title: content.step1Title, sub: content.step1Sub },
  { icon: "heroicons:cube",  title: content.step2Title, sub: content.step2Sub },
  { icon: "heroicons:truck", title: content.step3Title, sub: content.step3Sub },
];
---

<StoreLayout
  config={config}
  content={content}
  title={`${content.thankYouPageTitle} — ${config.name}`}
  noindex={true}
>
  <div class="max-w-lg mx-auto px-5 py-12 sm:py-20 text-center">
    <!-- Success icon -->
    <div
      class="w-24 h-24 rounded-[2rem] flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-8 shadow-xl animate-spring"
      style="background: var(--clr-surface); border: 4px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--clr-primary) 10%, white); color: var(--clr-primary)"
    >
      <Icon name="heroicons:check-circle" class="w-12 h-12" />
    </div>

    <h1 class="text-3xl font-black mb-3 tracking-tight" style="color: var(--clr-text)">
      {content.thankYouTitle}
    </h1>
    <p class="font-bold text-[1.0625rem] mb-10 text-balance px-4" style="color: var(--clr-text-2)">
      {content.thankYouSubtitle}
    </p>

    <!-- Order card (Ticket style) -->
    <div class="relative rounded-[2rem] border border-black/[.03] shadow-lg p-8 mb-10 text-start overflow-hidden" style="background: var(--clr-surface)">
      <div class="absolute -left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-6 h-6 bg-[var(--clr-bg)] rounded-full border-r border-black/[.03]"></div>
      <div class="absolute -right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-6 h-6 bg-[var(--clr-bg)] rounded-full border-l border-black/[.03]"></div>

      <div class="flex items-center justify-between pb-6 border-b border-dashed mb-6" style="border-color: var(--clr-border)">
        <span class="text-[0.6875rem] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.2em]" style="color: var(--clr-text-2)">
          {content.orderNumberLabel}
        </span>
        <span
          class="font-black text-xl tracking-wider"
          style="color: var(--clr-primary)"
        >
          {orderNumber}
        </span>
      </div>

      {totalFormatted && (
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
          <span class="text-sm font-bold" style="color: var(--clr-text-2)">{content.totalAmountLabel}</span>
          <span class="font-black text-2xl tracking-tight" style="color: var(--clr-text)">
            {totalFormatted} <span class="text-sm opacity-60 font-bold tracking-tighter uppercase">{config.currencySymbol}</span>
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl border" style="background: var(--clr-surface-alt); border-color: var(--clr-border)">
        <p class="text-[0.8125rem] font-black leading-relaxed flex items-center gap-2" style="color: var(--clr-text-2)">
          <Icon name="heroicons:credit-card" class="w-5 h-5 shrink-0 text-primary" />
          {content.codNote}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Steps -->
    <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 mb-12">
      {steps.map((step) => (
        <div class="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
          <div
            class="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm border border-black/[.03] text-primary"
            style="background: var(--clr-surface)"
          >
            <Icon name={step.icon} class="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <p class="text-[0.75rem] font-black leading-tight" style="color: var(--clr-text)">{step.title}</p>
          <p class="text-[0.625rem] font-bold" style="color: var(--clr-text-2)">{step.sub}</p>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>

    <a
      href="/"
      class="btn-primary !h-[3.75rem] !text-[1rem] active:scale-95 shadow-xl shadow-[var(--clr-primary)]/20"
    >
      {content.backToStore}
      <Icon name="heroicons:arrow-right" class:list={["w-5 h-5", isRTL ? 'rotate-180' : '']} />
    </a>
  </div>
</StoreLayout>

{pixelId && checkoutEvent && (
  <script type="text/javascript" set:html={`
(function() {
  if (typeof fbq !== 'function') return;
  var eventId = ${JSON.stringify(orderId)};
  // No orderId means no server mirror to deduplicate against — firing
  // with a different id would double-count the conversion. Skip instead.
  if (!eventId) return;
  var total   = ${JSON.stringify(totalNum)};
  var eventName = ${JSON.stringify(checkoutEvent)};
  fbq('track', eventName, total ? { value: total, currency: 'DZD' } : {}, { eventID: eventId });
})();
  `} />
)}

<script
  is:inline
  define:vars={{ orderNumber, orderId }}
>
  // Mark the abandoned-checkout session as converted (fire-and-forget).
  // The order POST redirects here (PRG), so the conversion signal fires on
  // the thank-you page — sessionStorage survives the redirect. keepalive
  // lets the request outlive the page if the user navigates on immediately.
  (function () {
    try {
      var sessionId = sessionStorage.getItem("cod_session_id");
      if (!sessionId) return;
      sessionStorage.removeItem("cod_session_id");
      fetch("/api/abandoned/convert", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          sessionId: sessionId,
          orderId: orderId,
          orderNumber: orderNumber,
        }),
        keepalive: true,
      }).catch(function () {});
    } catch (e) {
      // Non-critical — conversion tracking must never break the thank-you page
    }
  })();
</script>

```

# cod-astro/theme01/src/theme/components/category/CategoryPageContent.astro

```astro
---
// ── STREAMING COMPONENT ──
// Fetches category products and all categories, renders the category page
// Allows parent page to stream this after layout renders
import ProductCard from "@/theme/components/product/ProductCard.astro";
import { fetchProductsRaw, fetchCategoriesRaw } from "@/core/api/client";

interface Props {
  slug: string;
  currencySymbol: string;
  content: any;
  configName: string;
}

const { slug, currencySymbol, content, configName } = Astro.props;

// Fetch categories first to find the current one
const categories = await fetchCategoriesRaw();
const category = categories.find((c: any) => c.slug === slug);

if (!category) return Astro.redirect("/");

// Fetch products for this category
const products = await fetchProductsRaw({ categoryId: category.id });
---

<div class="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-5 py-8">
  <div class="mb-8">
    <h1 class="text-3xl font-black tracking-tight" style="color: var(--clr-text)">{category.name}</h1>
    <p class="text-[0.8125rem] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mt-1" style="color: var(--clr-text-2)">
      {products.length} {content.productCountLabel}
    </p>
    {category.description && (
      <p class="text-sm mt-3 max-w-2xl" style="color: var(--clr-text-2)">{category.description}</p>
    )}
  </div>

  <!-- Sub-categories (siblings) -->
  {categories.length > 1 && (
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 overflow-x-auto scrollbar-hide pb-4 mb-8 touch-pan-x">
      <a
        href="/products"
        data-astro-prefetch="hover"
        class="shrink-0 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-2xl text-[0.875rem] font-black border-2 active:scale-95 shadow-sm"
        style="border-color: var(--clr-border); background: var(--clr-surface); color: var(--clr-text-2)"
      >
        {content.allLabel}
      </a>
      {categories.map((cat) => (
        <a
          href={`/category/${cat.slug}`}
          data-astro-prefetch="hover"
          class:list={[
            "shrink-0 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-2xl text-[0.875rem] font-black border-2 transition-all active:scale-95 shadow-sm",
            cat.slug === slug
              ? "bg-[var(--clr-primary)] border-[var(--clr-primary)] text-white shadow-lg shadow-[var(--clr-primary)]/20 scale-105 mx-1"
              : "",
          ]}
          style={cat.slug !== slug ? "border-color: var(--clr-border); background: var(--clr-surface); color: var(--clr-text-2)" : ""}
        >
          {cat.name}
        </a>
      ))}
    </div>
  )}

  {products.length > 0 ? (
    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6">
      {products.map((p, i) => (
        <ProductCard
          product={p}
          currencySymbol={currencySymbol}
          eager={i < 4}
          content={content}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  ) : (
    <div class="py-24 text-center">
      <div class="w-20 h-20 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-4xl mx-auto mb-6" style="background: var(--clr-surface-alt)">🔍</div>
      <h2 class="text-xl font-black mb-2" style="color: var(--clr-text)">
        {content.noProductsTitle}
      </h2>
      <a
        href="/products"
        data-astro-prefetch="hover"
        class="btn-primary !w-auto !px-8 mt-6"
        aria-label={content.ariaBrowseAllProducts}
      >
        {content.viewAllCta}
      </a>
    </div>
  )}
</div>
```

# cod-astro/theme01/src/theme/components/home/CustomerTestimonials.astro

```astro
---
// ── STREAMING COMPONENT ──
// Customer testimonials from real product reviews
import type { StoreConfig } from "@/core/api/types";
import type { StoreFrontContent } from "@/theme/config/content";
import { fetchProductsRaw, fetchProductReviews } from "@/core/api/client";
import { Icon } from "astro-icon/components";

interface Props {
  config: StoreConfig;
  content: StoreFrontContent;
}

const { config, content } = Astro.props;

// Only render if reviews are enabled
let reviews: any[] = [];

if (config.reviewsEnabled) {
  // Fetch products that have reviews
  const products = await fetchProductsRaw();
  const withReviews = products
    .filter((p: any) => p.reviewStats && p.reviewStats.reviewCount > 0)
    .sort((a: any, b: any) => (b.reviewStats?.reviewCount ?? 0) - (a.reviewStats?.reviewCount ?? 0))
    .slice(0, 3);

  // Fetch actual reviews from top-reviewed products
  const reviewPromises = withReviews.map((p: any) =>
    fetchProductReviews(p.id, 2, 0)
  );
  const results = await Promise.all(reviewPromises);
  reviews = results
    .flatMap((r) => r.rows)
    .filter((r: any) => r.rating >= 4)
    .slice(0, 3);
}
---

{reviews.length > 0 && (
  <section class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-16 sm:py-24">
    <div class="text-center mb-16">
      <h2 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black tracking-tighter" style="color: var(--clr-text)">
        {content.testimonialsTitle}
      </h2>
      <p class="text-lg font-bold mt-4 opacity-50" style="color: var(--clr-text)">
        {content.testimonialsSub}
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8 lg:gap-12">
      {reviews.map((review: any) => (
        <div
          class="p-8 sm:p-10 flex flex-col justify-between transition-all duration-500 hover:shadow-2xl border border-black/[0.04] bg-white group hover:-translate-y-2"
          style={`border-radius: var(--radius-card)`}
        >
          <div>
            {/* Quote Icon */}
            <div class="text-primary opacity-20 mb-6 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-500">
              <svg width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
                <path d="M14.017 21L14.017 18C14.017 16.8954 14.9124 16 16.017 16H19.017C19.5693 16 20.017 15.5523 20.017 15V9C20.017 8.44772 19.5693 8 19.017 8H16.017C15.4647 8 15.017 8.44772 15.017 9V12C15.017 12.5523 14.5693 13 14.017 13H12.017V21H14.017ZM6.017 21L6.017 18C6.017 16.8954 6.91243 16 8.017 16H11.017C11.5693 16 12.017 15.5523 12.017 15V9C12.017 8.44772 11.5693 8 11.017 8H8.017C7.46472 8 7.017 8.44772 7.017 9V12C7.017 12.5523 6.56929 13 6.017 13H4.017V21H6.017Z" />
              </svg>
            </div>

            {/* Review body */}
            <p class="text-[1.0625rem] font-medium leading-relaxed mb-8 opacity-80" style="color: var(--clr-text)">
              “{review.body}”
            </p>
          </div>

          <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            {/* Customer name + verified badge */}
            <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
              <div
                class="w-12 h-12 flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-black text-white shrink-0 shadow-lg"
                style={`background: var(--clr-primary); border-radius: var(--radius-btn)`}
              >
                {review.customerName?.charAt(0)?.toUpperCase() ?? "?"}
              </div>
              <div class="min-w-0">
                <p class="text-[1rem] font-black truncate" style="color: var(--clr-text)">
                  {review.customerName}
                </p>
                <p class="text-[0.75rem] font-bold flex items-center gap-1" style="color: var(--clr-success)">
                  <Icon name="heroicons:check-circle" class="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  {content.reviewsVerifiedBuyer}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Star rating */}
            <div class="flex gap-0.5" aria-label={content.ariaStarRating?.replace("{n}", String(review.rating)).replace("{s}", review.rating > 1 ? "s" : "")}>
              {[1,2,3,4,5].map((s: number) => (
                <svg
                  width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  fill={s <= review.rating ? "var(--clr-primary)" : "none"}
                  stroke="var(--clr-primary)" stroke-width="2"
                  class="opacity-60"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                >
                  <polygon points="12 2 15.09 8.26 22 9.27 17 14.14 18.18 21.02 12 17.77 5.82 21.02 7 14.14 2 9.27 8.91 8.26 12 2"/>
                </svg>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  </section>
)}
```

# cod-astro/theme01/src/theme/components/home/FeaturedProducts.astro

```astro
---
// ── STREAMING COMPONENT ──
// Fetches products and renders featured/all products grid
// Allows parent page to stream this independently
import ProductCard from "@/theme/components/product/ProductCard.astro";
import { Icon } from "astro-icon/components";
import { fetchProductsRaw } from "@/core/api/client";

interface Props {
  currencySymbol: string;
  content: any;
}

const { currencySymbol, content } = Astro.props;

// Fetch products (this component streams when ready)
const allProducts = await fetchProductsRaw();
const featured = allProducts.filter((p: any) => p.storeFeatured);
const heroProducts = featured.length ? featured : allProducts.slice(0, 8);
const showViewAll = allProducts.length > 8;
---

{heroProducts.length > 0 ? (
  <section class="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-5 py-8">
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
      <h2 class="text-xl font-black tracking-tight" style="color: var(--clr-text)">
        {featured.length ? content.featuredSection : content.allProductsSection}
      </h2>
      {showViewAll && (
        <a
          href="/products"
          data-astro-prefetch="hover"
          class="text-[0.875rem] font-black transition-all active:opacity-60"
          style="color: var(--clr-primary)"
          aria-label={`${content.viewAllCta} - ${featured.length ? content.featuredSection : content.allProductsSection}`}
        >
          {content.viewAllCta}
        </a>
      )}
    </div>

    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6">
      {heroProducts.map((p, i) => (
        <ProductCard
          product={p}
          currencySymbol={currencySymbol}
          eager={i < 4}
        />
      ))}
    </div>

    {showViewAll && (
      <div class="text-center mt-12">
        <a
          href="/products"
          data-astro-prefetch="hover"
          class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-8 py-4 rounded-2xl font-black text-[1rem] border-2 active:scale-95 transition-all shadow-md"
          style="background: var(--clr-surface); border-color: var(--clr-primary); color: var(--clr-primary)"
          aria-label={`${content.viewAllCta} - Browse all ${allProducts.length} products`}
        >
          {content.viewAllCta}
        </a>
      </div>
    )}
  </section>
) : (
  <section class="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-5 py-24 text-center">
    <div class="w-24 h-24 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6 text-primary" style="background: var(--clr-surface-alt)">
      <Icon name="heroicons:shopping-bag" class="w-10 h-10" />
    </div>
    <h2 class="text-2xl font-black mb-2" style="color: var(--clr-text)">{content.emptyStoreTitle}</h2>
    <p class="font-bold" style="color: var(--clr-text-2)">{content.emptyStoreSub}</p>
  </section>
)}
```

```astro
// ── STREAMING COMPONENT ──
// New arrivals product grid (non-featured products, newest first)
import ProductCard from "@/theme/components/product/ProductCard.astro";
import { Icon } from "astro-icon/components";
import { fetchProductsRaw } from "@/core/api/client";
import type { StoreFrontContent } from "@/theme/config/content";

interface Props {
  currencySymbol: string;
  content: StoreFrontContent;
}

const { currencySymbol, content } = Astro.props;

const allProducts = await fetchProductsRaw();
// Exclude featured products to avoid duplication with BestSellers section
const nonFeatured = allProducts.filter((p: any) => !p.storeFeatured);
const products = nonFeatured.length ? nonFeatured.slice(0, 8) : allProducts.slice(0, 8);
const showViewAll = allProducts.length > 8;
---

{products.length > 0 && (
  <section id="new-arrivals" class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-16 sm:py-24">
    <div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end justify-between gap-6 mb-12">
      <div>
        <h2 class="text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-black tracking-tighter" style="color: var(--clr-text)">
          {content.newArrivalsSection}
        </h2>
        <p class="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold mt-3 opacity-60" style="color: var(--clr-text)">
          {content.newArrivalsSub}
        </p>
      </div>
      {showViewAll && (
        <a
          href="/products"
          class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-[1rem] font-black transition-all hover:text-primary group"
          style="color: var(--clr-text)"
          aria-label={`${content.viewAllCta} - ${content.newArrivalsSection}`}
        >
          {content.viewAllCta}
          <Icon name="heroicons:arrow-right" class="w-5 h-5 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-1 rtl:group-hover:-translate-x-1" />
        </a>
      )}
    </div>

    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6 lg:gap-8">
      {products.map((p: any) => (
        <ProductCard
          product={p}
          currencySymbol={currencySymbol}
          content={content}
          eager={false}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  </section>
)}
```

# cod-astro/theme01/src/theme/components/layout/BaseHead.astro

```astro
---
// View transitions removed — ClientRouter caused dynamic module scripts
// fetches on soft navigation to be served with empty Content-Type by the
// SSR worker, breaking strict-MIME-checked module loading. After that
// failure, product.ts never executed and every interactive element
// (variant pills, offers, dropdowns, qty stepper) appeared "blocked".
// We don't actually navigate between pages on the storefront — full page
// loads are fine and removed the regression entirely.

interface Props {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  ogImage: string;
  noindex?: boolean;
  config: any;
  primary: string;
  fontHref: string;
  font: string;
  bg: string;
  accent: string;
  /** The page's LCP images (landing page stack top) — preloaded in <head>
   *  so their fetch starts before the parser reaches the <img> tags. */
  preloadImages?: string[];
}

const { title, description, ogImage, noindex, config, primary, fontHref, font, bg, accent, preloadImages } = Astro.props;

import { MEDIA_DOMAIN } from "astro:env/server";
---

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover" />
  <meta name="generator" content={Astro.generator} />
  <meta name="theme-color" content={primary} />
  <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes" />
  <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="default" />
  <link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico" sizes="any" />
  <title>{title}</title>
  <meta name="description" content={description} />
  {noindex && <meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow" />}

  <!-- SEO -->
  <link rel="canonical" href={Astro.url.href} />
  <meta name="author" content={config.name} />

  <!-- OG -->
  <meta property="og:title" content={title} />
  <meta property="og:site_name" content={config.name} />
  <meta property="og:url" content={Astro.url.href} />
  <meta property="og:description" content={description} />
  {ogImage && <meta property="og:image" content={ogImage} />}
  <meta property="og:type" content="website" />
  <meta property="og:locale" content={config.lang === "ar" ? "ar_DZ" : "en_US"} />

  <!-- Twitter -->
  <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image" />
  <meta name="twitter:title" content={title} />
  <meta name="twitter:description" content={description} />
  {ogImage && <meta name="twitter:image" content={ogImage} />}

  <!-- Fonts -->
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href={fontHref} rel="stylesheet" media="print" onload="this.media='all'" />
  <noscript><link href={fontHref} rel="stylesheet" /></noscript>

  <!-- R2 media domain — early connection for product images -->
  {MEDIA_DOMAIN && <link rel="preconnect" href={`https://${MEDIA_DOMAIN}`} />}

  <!-- LCP image preload — starts the first stack images' fetches from the
       head (fetchpriority on the img alone waits for the parser to reach it).
       Only the first is high priority: preloading deep stack images would
       compete with the LCP for mobile bandwidth. -->
  {preloadImages?.slice(0, 2).map((src, i) => (
    <link rel="preload" as="image" href={src} fetchpriority={i === 0 ? "high" : undefined} />
  ))}

  <!-- Meta Pixel — canonical base code, unmodified. fbevents.js ships its own
       command queue: every fbq() call made before the library arrives (incl.
       ViewContent/InitiateCheckout from product.ts) is buffered and flushed
       automatically once it loads. Do not defer or custom-load it — a
       hand-rolled loader delays or drops events whenever window.load or the
       script fetch misbehaves. -->
  {config.pixelId && (
    <Fragment>
      <script type="text/javascript" set:html={`
!function(f,b,e,v,n,t,s)
{if(f.fbq)return;n=f.fbq=function(){n.callMethod?
n.callMethod.apply(n,arguments):n.queue.push(arguments)};
if(!f._fbq)f._fbq=n;n.push=n;n.loaded=!0;n.version='2.0';
n.queue=[];t=b.createElement(e);t.async=!0;
t.src=v;s=b.getElementsByTagName(e)[0];
s.parentNode.insertBefore(t,s)}(window, document,'script',
'https://connect.facebook.net/en_US/fbevents.js');
fbq('init', '${config.pixelId}');
fbq('track', 'PageView');
      `} />
      <noscript>
        <img height="1" width="1" style="display:none"
          src={`https://www.facebook.com/tr?id=${config.pixelId}&ev=PageView&noscript=1`}
          alt=""
        />
      </noscript>
    </Fragment>
  )}

  <!-- Dynamic theme tokens + Critical CSS -->
  <style set:html={`
    :root {
      --clr-primary: ${primary};
      --clr-accent:  ${accent};
      --clr-bg:      ${bg};
      --font-body:   ${font};
      --safe-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
      --safe-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
    }
    /* Critical above-the-fold styles */
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; height: -webkit-fill-available; }
    body {
      font-family: var(--font-body), "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
      background: var(--clr-bg);
      color: var(--clr-text);
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
      min-height: 100vh;
      line-height: 1.5;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      margin: 0;
    }
  `} />
</head>

```

```astro
];

<footer class="mt-8 border-t border-black/[0.04] pb-16 sm:pb-4" style="background: var(--clr-surface)">

                <span class="text-[0.8125rem] sm:text-[0.875rem] font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer" style="color: var(--clr-text-2)">

</footer>
```

```astro
---
import type { StoreConfig } from "@/core/api/types";
import type { StoreFrontContent } from "@/theme/config/content";
import { Icon } from "astro-icon/components";

interface Props {
  config: StoreConfig;
  content?: StoreFrontContent;
}

const { config, content } = Astro.props;
const path = Astro.url.pathname;

const items = [
  {
    label: content?.navHome ?? "Home",
    href: "/",
    active: path === "/",
    icon: "heroicons:home",
  },
  {
    label: content?.navProducts ?? "Products",
    href: "/products",
    active: path.startsWith("/products"),
    icon: "heroicons:squares-2x2",
  },
];
---

<nav class="mobile-nav sm:hidden" aria-label={content?.ariaMainNavigation ?? "Main navigation"}>
  {items.map((item) => (
    <a
      href={item.href}
      aria-label={item.label}
      aria-current={item.active ? "page" : undefined}
      class:list={[
        "mobile-nav-item active:scale-95",
        item.active ? "active" : ""
      ]}
    >
      <span aria-hidden="true"><Icon name={item.icon} class="w-5 h-5" /></span>
      <span>{item.label}</span>
    </a>
  ))}
</nav>
```

# cod-astro/theme01/src/theme/components/order/CustomerFields.astro

```astro
---
import Select from "@/theme/components/ui/Select.astro";
import { Icon } from "astro-icon/components";
import { WILAYAS } from "@/core/data/wilayas";

interface Props {
  content: any;
  fieldErrors: any;
  isRTL: boolean;
  showCommune?: boolean;
}

const { content, fieldErrors, isRTL, showCommune = true } = Astro.props;
---

<div class="cod-customer-grid">
  <!-- Name -->
  <div class="cod-customer-field cod-field">
    <input
      id="f-name" type="text" name="customerName"
      required autocomplete="name"
      placeholder={content.formNamePlaceholder}
      aria-label={content.formNameLabel}
      class:list={["cod-input", fieldErrors.customerName && "error"]}
    />
    <div class="cod-field-icon"><Icon name="heroicons:user" /></div>
    {fieldErrors.customerName && (
      <p class="text-[0.75rem] text-red-500 font-bold mt-2 ps-1">{fieldErrors.customerName[0]}</p>
    )}
  </div>

  <!-- Phone -->
  <div class="cod-customer-field cod-field">
    <input
      id="f-phone" type="tel" name="phone"
      required autocomplete="tel" inputmode="tel"
      placeholder={content.formPhonePlaceholder}
      aria-label={content.formPhoneLabel}
      dir="ltr"
      class:list={["cod-input", fieldErrors.phone && "error"]}
    />
    <div class="cod-field-icon cod-field-icon--start"><Icon name="heroicons:phone" /></div>
    {fieldErrors.phone && (
      <p class="text-[0.75rem] text-red-500 font-bold mt-2 ps-1">{fieldErrors.phone[0]}</p>
    )}
  </div>

  <!-- Wilaya -->
  <div class:list={["cod-customer-field", "cod-customer-select", !showCommune && "cod-customer-span"]}>
    <Select
      id="f-wilaya"
      name="wilayaId"
      label={content.formWilayaLabel}
      placeholder={content.formWilayaPlaceholder}
      searchPlaceholder={content.searchLabel}
      noResultsText={content.noResultsLabel}
      required={true}
      error={fieldErrors.wilayaId?.[0]}
      options={WILAYAS.map(w => ({
        value: w.id,
        label: `${w.id.toString().padStart(2, "0")} — ${isRTL ? w.nameAr : w.name}`
      }))}
    />
    {fieldErrors.wilayaId && (
      <p class="text-[0.75rem] text-red-500 font-bold mt-2 ps-1">{fieldErrors.wilayaId[0]}</p>
    )}
  </div>

  <!-- Commune — hidden when the store disables it in dashboard settings -->
  {showCommune && (
    <div class="cod-customer-field cod-customer-select">
      <Select
        id="f-commune"
        name="communeId"
        label={content.formCommuneLabel}
        placeholder={content.formCommuneDisabled}
        searchPlaceholder={content.searchLabel}
        noResultsText={content.noResultsLabel}
        required={true}
        error={fieldErrors.communeId?.[0]}
        options={[]}
        dynamic={true}
      />
      {fieldErrors.communeId && (
        <p class="text-[0.75rem] text-red-500 font-bold mt-2 ps-1">{fieldErrors.communeId[0]}</p>
      )}
    </div>
  )}

  <input type="hidden" name="deliveryType" value="home" />

  <!-- Address -->
  <div id="address-field-container" class="cod-customer-span cod-field cod-address-field">
    <input
      id="f-address" type="text" name="address"
      autocomplete="street-address"
      placeholder={content.formAddressPlaceholder}
      aria-label={content.formAddressLabel}
      class="cod-input"
    />
    <div class="cod-field-icon"><Icon name="heroicons:map-pin" /></div>
  </div>

  <!-- Notes -->
  <div class="cod-customer-span cod-notes-field">
    <textarea
      id="f-notes" name="notes" rows="2"
      placeholder={content.formNotesPlaceholder}
      aria-label={content.formNotesLabel}
      class="cod-input"
    ></textarea>
  </div>
</div>
```

# cod-astro/theme01/src/theme/components/order/OfferTiers.astro

```astro
---
import type { Product, Offer } from "@/core/api/types";
import type { StoreFrontContent } from "@/theme/config/content";
import { Icon } from "astro-icon/components";

interface Props {
  product: Product;
  offers: Offer[];
  basePrice: number;
  comparePrice: number | null;
  cur: string;
  isRTL: boolean;
  content: StoreFrontContent;
  defaultVariantId: string | null;
}

const { product, offers, basePrice, comparePrice, cur, isRTL, content, defaultVariantId } = Astro.props;
const hasVariants = product.hasVariants && product.variantOptions && product.variantOptions.length > 0;

function fmt(n: number) {
  return n.toLocaleString("ar-DZ");
}

function varVal(variations: unknown, key: string): string | undefined {
  return (variations as Record<string, string>)[key];
}
---

{offers.length > 0 ? (
  <div class="cod-offer-tiers-wrap">
    <div class="space-y-2.5" id="offer-tier-section">

    <!-- Section header -->
    <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-1">
      <div class="h-px flex-1 bg-black/[.06]"></div>
      <span class="text-[0.625rem] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.22em]" style="color: var(--clr-text)">{content.offerSectionTitle}</span>
      <div class="h-px flex-1 bg-black/[.06]"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- ── Base tier: Buy 1 ── -->
    <label
      id="tier-card-base"
      class="tier-label relative flex flex-col rounded-[1.125rem] border-2 cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-150 select-none overflow-hidden"
      style="border-color: var(--clr-primary); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--clr-primary) 4%, white)"
      data-qty="1"
      data-offer-id=""
    >
      <input type="radio" name="tierSelect" value="base" class="sr-only" checked />

      <!-- Header row -->
      <div class="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 pt-4 pb-3.5">
        <!-- Radio dot -->
        <div class="tier-check w-[1.125rem] h-[1.125rem] rounded-full border-[2px] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 transition-all duration-150" style="border-color: var(--clr-primary); background: var(--clr-primary)">
          <Icon name="heroicons:check" class="w-2 h-2 text-white" />
        </div>

        <!-- Title + badge -->
        <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <span class="font-black text-[0.9375rem] leading-tight" style="color: var(--clr-text)">{content.offerBuyOne}</span>
            <span class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[0.5625rem] font-black uppercase tracking-wide leading-none" style="background: var(--clr-surface-alt); color: var(--clr-text)">{content.offerFullPrice}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Price -->
        <div class="text-end shrink-0">
          <span class="font-black text-[1rem] leading-none" style="color: var(--clr-primary)" id="tier-price-base">
            {fmt(basePrice)}&nbsp;<span class="text-[0.5625rem] font-black">{cur}</span>
          </span>
          {comparePrice != null && (
            <div class="text-[0.625rem] line-through font-bold mt-0.5" style="color: var(--clr-text)">{fmt(comparePrice)} {cur}</div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Variant pills — visible when base tier is active -->
      {hasVariants && (
        <div id="tier-variants-base" class="px-4 pb-4 pt-2.5 border-t space-y-3" style="border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--clr-primary) 12%, transparent)">
          {product.variantOptions!.map((opt) => (
            <div>
              <p class="text-[0.5625rem] font-black uppercase tracking-widest mb-2" style="color: var(--clr-text)">{opt.name}</p>
              <div class="flex gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                {opt.values.map((val, vi) => (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    class:list={[
                      "variant-opt shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1.5 h-8 px-3 rounded-[0.625rem] border-2 font-bold text-[0.8125rem] transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 whitespace-nowrap",
                      vi === 0
                        ? "text-[var(--clr-primary)] bg-[var(--clr-primary)]/5 border-[var(--clr-primary)]"
                        : ""
                    ]}
                    style={vi !== 0 ? "border-color: var(--clr-border); background: var(--clr-surface); color: var(--clr-text-2)" : undefined}
                    data-option={opt.name}
                    data-value={val.value}
                    data-first={vi === 0 ? "1" : ""}
                  >
                    {val.hexColor && (
                      <span class="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full shrink-0 border border-black/[.08]" style={`background: ${val.hexColor}`}></span>
                    )}
                    <span class="leading-none">{val.value}</span>
                    <span class:list={["check-icon transition-opacity duration-150 shrink-0", vi === 0 ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0"]} style="color: var(--clr-primary)">
                      <Icon name="heroicons:check" class="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                    </span>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </label>

    <!-- ── Offer tiers ── -->
    {offers.map((offer, i) => {
      const isFreeShipping   = offer.discountType === "free_shipping";
      const savePct          = !isFreeShipping
        ? Math.round(offer.rewardQuantity / (offer.triggerQuantity + offer.rewardQuantity) * 100)
        : 0;
      const savingsAmt       = !isFreeShipping ? offer.rewardQuantity * basePrice : 0;
      const tierPrice        = basePrice * offer.triggerQuantity;
      const tierCompare      = comparePrice != null ? comparePrice * offer.triggerQuantity : null;
      const shownByDefault   = !offer.triggerVariantId || offer.triggerVariantId === defaultVariantId;
      const lockedVariant    = offer.triggerVariantId
        ? product.variants.find(v => v.id === offer.triggerVariantId)
        : null;
      const rewardLabel      = offer.rewardProductName + (offer.rewardVariantLabel ? ` — ${offer.rewardVariantLabel}` : "");

      return (
        <label
          id={`tier-card-${offer.id}`}
          class:list={[
            "tier-label relative flex flex-col rounded-[1.125rem] border-2 cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-150 select-none overflow-hidden",
            !shownByDefault && "hidden"
          ]}
          style="border-color: var(--clr-border); background: var(--clr-surface)"
          data-qty={offer.triggerQuantity}
          data-offer-id={offer.id}
          data-discount-type={offer.discountType}
        >
          <input type="radio" name="tierSelect" value={offer.id} class="sr-only" />

          {/* Top accent stripe — first offer */}
          {i === 0 && (
            <div class="h-[3px] w-full shrink-0" style="background: var(--clr-primary)"></div>
          )}

          <!-- Header row -->
          <div class:list={["flex items-start gap-3 px-4 pb-3.5", i === 0 ? "pt-3" : "pt-4"]}>

            <!-- Radio dot -->
            <div class="tier-check w-[1.125rem] h-[1.125rem] rounded-full border-[2px] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-[3px] transition-all duration-150" style="border-color: var(--clr-border); background: var(--clr-surface)">
              <Icon name="heroicons:check" class="w-2 h-2 text-transparent" />
            </div>

            <!-- Labels -->
            <div class="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-1.5">
              <!-- Name + badge row -->
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <span class="font-black text-[0.9375rem] leading-tight" style="color: var(--clr-text)">{offer.name}</span>
                {i === 0 && (
                  <span class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-white text-[0.5625rem] font-black uppercase tracking-wide leading-none" style="background: var(--clr-primary)">
                    {content.offerMostPopular}
                  </span>
                )}
                {isFreeShipping ? (
                  <span class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-white text-[0.5625rem] font-black uppercase tracking-wide leading-none shrink-0" style="background: var(--clr-success)">
                    {content.offerFreeShippingBadge}
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <span class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-white text-[0.5625rem] font-black uppercase tracking-wide leading-none shrink-0" style="background: var(--clr-primary)">
                    {content.offerSaveBadge.replace("{n}", String(savePct))}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>

              <!-- Reward / savings line -->
              {isFreeShipping ? (
                <p class="text-[0.75rem] font-black leading-tight flex items-center gap-1.5" style="color: var(--clr-success)">
                  <Icon name="heroicons:truck" class="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" /> {content.offerFreeShippingBadge}
                </p>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <p class="text-[0.75rem] font-black leading-tight flex items-center gap-1.5" style="color: var(--clr-success)">
                    <Icon name="heroicons:gift" class="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" /> {rewardLabel} — {content.offerFreeLabel}
                  </p>
                  {savingsAmt > 0 && (
                    <p class="text-[0.6875rem] font-bold leading-none" style="color: var(--clr-text-2)">
                      {content.offerSavingsText.replace("{amount}", fmt(savingsAmt)).replace("{currency}", cur)}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </>
              )}
            </div>

            <!-- Price -->
            <div class="text-end shrink-0 mt-0.5">
              <span class="font-black text-[1rem] leading-none" style="color: var(--clr-primary)" id={`tier-price-${offer.id}`}>
                {fmt(tierPrice)}&nbsp;<span class="text-[0.5625rem] font-black">{cur}</span>
              </span>
              {tierCompare != null && (
                <div class="text-[0.625rem] line-through font-bold mt-0.5" style="color: var(--clr-text)">{fmt(tierCompare)} {cur}</div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Per-unit variant pills — shown when this offer is selected -->
          {hasVariants && (
            <div id={`tier-variants-${offer.id}`} class="hidden px-4 pb-4 pt-3 border-t border-black/[.05]">
              {Array.from({ length: offer.triggerQuantity }, (_, unitIndex) => (
                <div class:list={["space-y-2.5", unitIndex > 0 && "mt-3.5 pt-3.5 border-t border-dashed"]} style={unitIndex > 0 ? "border-color: var(--clr-border)" : undefined}>

                  <!-- Unit label -->
                  <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span class="w-[1.125rem] h-[1.125rem] rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[0.5rem] font-black text-white shrink-0" style="background: var(--clr-primary)">
                      {unitIndex + 1}
                    </span>
                    <span class="text-[0.625rem] font-black uppercase tracking-widest" style="color: var(--clr-text)">
                      {content.offerUnitLabel.replace("{n}", String(unitIndex + 1))}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <!-- Option groups -->
                  {product.variantOptions!.map((opt) => {
                    const lockedValue = lockedVariant
                      ? varVal(lockedVariant.variations, opt.name)
                      : null;
                    return (
                      <div>
                        <p class="text-[0.5625rem] font-black uppercase tracking-widest mb-1.5" style="color: var(--clr-text)">{opt.name}</p>
                        <div class="flex gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                          {opt.values.map((val, vi) => {
                            const isActive     = lockedValue ? lockedValue === val.value : vi === 0;
                            const isHidden     = !!lockedValue && lockedValue !== val.value;
                            return !isHidden ? (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                class:list={[
                                  "tier-unit-opt h-8 px-2.5 rounded-[0.5625rem] border-2 font-bold text-[0.75rem] transition-all duration-150 flex items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap",
                                  isActive
                                    ? "text-[var(--clr-primary)] bg-[var(--clr-primary)]/5 border-[var(--clr-primary)]"
                                    : "active:scale-95",
                                  !!lockedValue && "pointer-events-none"
                                ]}
                                style={!isActive ? "border-color: var(--clr-border); background: var(--clr-surface); color: var(--clr-text-2)" : undefined}
                                data-tier-id={offer.id}
                                data-unit={unitIndex}
                                data-option={opt.name}
                                data-value={val.value}
                                data-active={isActive ? "1" : "0"}
                              >
                                {val.hexColor && (
                                  <span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full shrink-0 border border-black/[.08]" style={`background: ${val.hexColor}`}></span>
                                )}
                                <span class="leading-none">{val.value}</span>
                              </button>
                            ) : null;
                          })}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </label>
      );
    })}

    <input type="number" name="quantity" id="qty-input" value="1" min="1" max="100" class="sr-only" aria-label={content.ariaQuantity} />
    </div>
  </div>
) : (
  <div class="cod-quantity-section">
    <!-- No offers: standalone quantity stepper -->
    <div class="cod-quantity-copy">
      <p class="cod-quantity-label font-black text-[0.9375rem]" style="color: var(--clr-text)">{content.qtyLabel}</p>
      <p class="cod-quantity-sub text-[0.75rem] font-bold mt-0.5" style="color: var(--clr-text-2)">{content.qtyUnit}</p>
    </div>
    <div class="cod-qty shrink-0">
      <button type="button" id="qty-minus" class="cod-qty-btn cod-qty-minus" aria-label={content.ariaQuantity}>−</button>
      <input type="number" name="quantity" id="qty-input" value="1" min="1" max="100" inputmode="numeric" class="cod-qty-input cod-qty-value" aria-label={content.ariaQuantity} />
      <button type="button" id="qty-plus" class="cod-qty-btn cod-qty-plus" aria-label={content.ariaQuantity}>+</button>
    </div>
  </div>
)}
<p id="qty-stock-hint" class="cod-qty-stock-hint text-[0.75rem] text-amber-600 font-bold text-end hidden mt-1" aria-live="polite"></p>
```

# cod-astro/theme01/src/theme/components/order/OrderForm.astro

```astro
---
import { actions } from "astro:actions";
import type { Product, ProductVariant, Offer } from "@/core/api/types";
import type { StoreFrontContent } from "@/theme/config/content";
import { Icon } from "astro-icon/components";

import VariantSelector from "./VariantSelector.astro";
import OfferTiers from "./OfferTiers.astro";
import CustomerFields from "./CustomerFields.astro";
import OrderSummary from "./OrderSummary.astro";
import OtpStep from "./OtpStep.astro";
import TurnstileField from "./TurnstileField.astro";

interface Props {
  product: Product;
  content: StoreFrontContent;
  fieldErrors: Record<string, string[] | undefined>;
  serverError: string | null;
  basePrice: number;
  defaultVariant: ProductVariant | null;
  cur: string;
  isRTL: boolean;
  offers: Offer[];
  defaultVariantId: string | null;
  isOutOfStock?: boolean;
  otpEnabled?: boolean;
  turnstileEnabled?: boolean;
  turnstileSiteKey?: string | null;
  showCommune?: boolean;
  /** Landing page attribution — rides the form like fbc/fbp (best-effort). */
  landingPageSlug?: string | null;
}

const { product, content, fieldErrors, serverError, basePrice, defaultVariant, cur, isRTL, offers, defaultVariantId, isOutOfStock = false, otpEnabled = false, turnstileEnabled = false, turnstileSiteKey = null, landingPageSlug = null, showCommune = true } = Astro.props;

const comparePrice = defaultVariant?.compareAtPrice ?? product.compareAtPrice ?? null;
---

<!-- Order form card -->
<div class="cod-checkout card !border-none !shadow-lg sm:!border sm:!shadow-md" id="order-section">
  <!-- Card header -->
  <div class="cod-order-head">
    <div class="cod-order-head-name">
      {product.name}
    </div>

    <div class="cod-order-head-price">
      {basePrice.toLocaleString("ar-DZ")} {cur}
    </div>
  </div>

  {serverError && (
    <div class="mx-6 mt-6 p-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-100 rounded-[1.25rem] text-[0.875rem] font-bold text-red-600 flex items-start gap-3">
      <Icon name="heroicons:exclamation-triangle" class="w-5 h-5 shrink-0" />
      <p>{serverError}</p>
    </div>
  )}

  <form method="POST" action={actions.placeOrder} class="p-6 space-y-6">
    <!-- Hidden product fields -->
    <input type="hidden" name="productId"          value={product.id} />
    <!-- Meta Pixel tracking (populated by JS at submit time) -->
    <input type="hidden" name="fbc" id="fbc-input" value="" />
    <input type="hidden" name="fbp" id="fbp-input" value="" />
    <input type="hidden" name="productName"        value={product.name} />
    <input type="hidden" name="pricePerUnit"       value={basePrice} id="price-input" />
    <input type="hidden" name="variantId"          value={defaultVariant?.id ?? ""} id="variant-id-input" />
    <input type="hidden" name="variantLabel"       value="" id="variant-label-input" />
    <input type="hidden" name="offerId"            value="" id="offer-id-input" />
    <input type="hidden" name="variantSelections"  value="[]" id="variant-selections-input" />
    {/* WhatsApp OTP proof — set by the OTP step script after verification */}
    <input type="hidden" name="otpToken" id="otp-token-input" value="" />
    {/* Landing page attribution — present only on landing pages */}
    {landingPageSlug && <input type="hidden" name="landingPageSlug" value={landingPageSlug} />}

    {/* Standalone variant selector only when no offers — otherwise it lives inside the tier cards */}
    {offers.length === 0 && <VariantSelector product={product} />}

    <OfferTiers
      product={product}
      offers={offers}
      basePrice={basePrice}
      comparePrice={comparePrice}
      cur={cur}
      isRTL={isRTL}
      content={content}
      defaultVariantId={defaultVariantId}
    />

    <CustomerFields
      content={content}
      fieldErrors={fieldErrors}
      isRTL={isRTL}
      showCommune={showCommune}
    />

    {otpEnabled && <OtpStep content={content} isRTL={isRTL} />}

    {turnstileEnabled && turnstileSiteKey && (
      <TurnstileField siteKey={turnstileSiteKey} content={content} />
    )}

    <!-- Submit -->
    <button
      type="submit"
      class:list={[
        "cod-submit",
        isOutOfStock && "cursor-not-allowed"
      ]}
      id="submit-btn"
      disabled={isOutOfStock || undefined}
    >
      {isOutOfStock ? content.outOfStock : content.formSubmit}
    </button>

    <OrderSummary
      product={product}
      basePrice={basePrice}
      cur={cur}
      offers={offers}
      content={content}
    />

    <p class="text-center text-[0.8125rem] font-bold px-4" style="color: var(--clr-text-2)">
      {content.formConfirmNote}
    </p>
  </form>
</div>

```

```astro
import type { Product, Offer } from "@/core/api/types";
import type { StoreFrontContent } from "@/theme/config/content";

interface Props {

  basePrice: number;

}

<section class="cod-summary" id="order-summary">

    <Icon name="heroicons:chevron-up" class="cod-summary-chevron w-5 h-5" style="color: var(--clr-text-2)" aria-hidden="true" />

          </div>

            {fmt(basePrice)} {cur}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

    <!-- Shipping line -->

    <!-- Offer rows -->

              <span class="shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap">{content.offerFreeLabel}</span>
            </>
          )}

      );
    })}

    <!-- Total bar -->
    <div class="cod-summary-total">
      <span>{content.totalLabel}</span>
      <span class="cod-summary-total-price" id="summary-total">
        {fmt(basePrice)} {cur}
      </span>

</section>
```

```astro
      </button>

        {content.otpChangePhone}
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

# cod-astro/theme01/src/theme/components/order/TurnstileField.astro

```astro
---
/**
 * Cloudflare Turnstile field for the checkout form (theme layer).
 *
 * Rendered only when the store enables Turnstile — hidden otherwise, and the
 * widget script never loads. Managed widget with `interaction-only`
 * appearance: invisible during normal checkout, a checkbox only when
 * Cloudflare's risk engine demands one. The widget injects its single-use
 * token into a hidden input named `turnstileToken`, which rides the native
 * form POST (same path as otpToken/fbc/fbp).
 *
 * Callbacks (success / expire / error / timeout) are window functions
 * installed by src/theme/scripts/turnstile-field.ts — referenced by name so
 * the bundled module only needs to exist before the widget fires those
 * events. `retry: auto` lets transient widget failures self-heal.
 */
import { Icon } from "astro-icon/components";
import type { StoreFrontContent } from "@/theme/config/content";

interface Props {
  siteKey: string;
  content: StoreFrontContent;
}

const { siteKey, content } = Astro.props;

const turnstileStrings = JSON.stringify({
  turnstileErrorFailed: content.turnstileErrorFailed,
  turnstileVerifying: content.turnstileVerifying,
});
---

<div id="turnstile-field" data-strings={turnstileStrings}>
  <div
    id="turnstile-error"
    class="hidden p-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-100 rounded-[1.25rem] text-[0.875rem] font-bold text-red-600 flex items-start gap-3"
    role="alert"
  >
    <Icon name="heroicons:exclamation-triangle" class="w-5 h-5 shrink-0" />
    <p></p>
  </div>
  <div
    class="cf-turnstile"
    data-sitekey={siteKey}
    data-theme="auto"
    data-appearance="interaction-only"
    data-action="place-order"
    data-response-field-name="turnstileToken"
    data-retry="auto"
    data-callback="__codflowTurnstileSuccess"
    data-expired-callback="__codflowTurnstileExpired"
    data-error-callback="__codflowTurnstileError"
    data-timeout-callback="__codflowTurnstileTimeout"
  >
  </div>
</div>

<script is:inline async defer src="https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js"></script>
```

# cod-astro/theme01/src/theme/components/order/VariantSelector.astro

```astro
---
import type { Product } from "@/core/api/types";
import { Icon } from "astro-icon/components";

interface Props {
  product: Product;
}

const { product } = Astro.props;

// Returns true if ALL variants with this option value are out of stock
function isValueOos(optName: string, optValue: string): boolean {
  if (!product.trackInventory) return false;
  const matching = product.variants.filter((v) => v.variations[optName] === optValue);
  if (matching.length === 0) return false;
  return matching.every((v) => v.inventory === 0);
}

// Per option: index of first in-stock value (falls back to 0 if all OOS)
function firstInStockIdx(optName: string): number {
  if (!product.trackInventory) return 0;
  const opt = product.variantOptions?.find((o) => o.name === optName);
  if (!opt) return 0;
  const idx = opt.values.findIndex((v) => !isValueOos(optName, v.value));
  return idx >= 0 ? idx : 0;
}
---

{product.hasVariants && product.variantOptions && product.variants.length > 0 && (
  <div class="space-y-4">
    {product.variantOptions.map((opt) => {
      const defaultIdx = firstInStockIdx(opt.name);
      return (
        <div class="space-y-2">
          <span class="text-[0.75rem] font-black uppercase tracking-widest" style="color: var(--clr-text-2)">{opt.name}</span>
          <!-- -mx-6 px-6 lets the scroll bleed to card edges without clipping -->
          <div class="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto -mx-6 px-6 pb-1 scrollbar-hide">
            {opt.values.map((val, vi) => {
              const oos = isValueOos(opt.name, val.value);
              return (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  class:list={[
                    "variant-opt shrink-0 flex items-center gap-2 h-10 px-4 rounded-xl border-2 transition-all duration-200 whitespace-nowrap",
                    oos
                      ? "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed line-through"
                      : "active:scale-95"
                  ]}
                  style="border-color: var(--clr-border); background: var(--clr-surface); color: var(--clr-text-2)"
                  data-option={opt.name}
                  data-value={val.value}
                  data-first={vi === defaultIdx && !oos ? "1" : ""}
                  data-oos={oos ? "1" : ""}
                  aria-label={val.value}
                  aria-disabled={oos ? "true" : undefined}
                >
                  {val.hexColor && (
                    <span
                      class="w-[1.125rem] h-[1.125rem] rounded-full shrink-0 border border-black/10 shadow-sm"
                      style={`background: ${val.hexColor}${oos ? "; opacity: 0.4" : ""}`}
                    ></span>
                  )}
                  <span class="font-bold text-[0.875rem] leading-none">{val.value}</span>
                  {!oos && (
                    <span class="check-icon opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-200 shrink-0 text-[var(--clr-primary)]">
                      <Icon name="heroicons:check" class="w-3 h-3" />
                    </span>
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    })}
  </div>
)}
```

# cod-astro/theme01/src/theme/components/product/ProductCard.astro

```astro
---
// ── CUSTOMIZE HERE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Product card used on the home page, all-products page, and category pages.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import { Image } from "astro:assets";
import type { Product } from "@/core/api/types";
import type { StoreFrontContent } from "@/theme/config/content";
import { Icon } from "astro-icon/components";

interface Props {
  product: Product;
  currencySymbol?: string;
  eager?: boolean;
  content?: StoreFrontContent;
}

const { product, currencySymbol = "دج", eager = false, content } = Astro.props;

const image        = product.coverImage ?? product.images?.[0];
const hasDiscount  = product.compareAtPrice != null && product.compareAtPrice > product.price;
const discountPct  = hasDiscount ? Math.round((1 - product.price / product.compareAtPrice!) * 100) : 0;
const isLowStock   = product.trackInventory && product.inventory > 0 && product.inventory <= 5;
const isOutOfStock = product.trackInventory && product.inventory === 0;

const ctaText      = content?.orderCta    ?? "اطلب الآن";
const outOfStockTx = content?.outOfStock  ?? "نفد المخزون";
const lowStockTx   = content?.lowStock
  ? content.lowStock.replace("{n}", String(product.inventory))
  : `آخر ${product.inventory} قطع`;
---

<a
  href={`/products/${product.handle}`}
  data-astro-prefetch="hover"
  class="product-card group flex flex-col rounded-2xl overflow-hidden active:scale-[0.97]"
  style="background: var(--clr-surface)"
  aria-label={content?.ariaProductCard
    ?.replace("{name}", product.name)
    ?.replace("{price}", product.price.toLocaleString("ar-DZ"))
    ?.replace("{currency}", currencySymbol) ?? product.name}
>
  <!-- ── Image ── -->
  <div class="relative aspect-square overflow-hidden shrink-0" style="background: var(--clr-surface-alt)">
    {image ? (
      <Image
        src={image.src}
        alt={image.altText ?? product.name}
        width={400}
        height={400}
        loading={eager ? "eager" : "lazy"}
        decoding="async"
        format="webp"
        quality={85}
        class="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-500 ease-out"
      />
    ) : (
      <div class="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center opacity-20" style="color: var(--clr-text-2)" aria-hidden="true">
        <Icon name="heroicons:photo" class="w-12 h-12" />
      </div>
    )}

    <!-- Discount badge -->
    {hasDiscount && (
      <div class="absolute top-3 start-3" aria-hidden="true">
        <span class="bg-red-600 text-white text-xs font-black px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg shadow-md tracking-tight">
          -{discountPct}%
        </span>
      </div>
    )}

    <!-- Out of stock overlay -->
    {isOutOfStock && (
      <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center" aria-hidden="true">
        <span class="bg-black/80 text-white text-sm font-black px-4 py-2 rounded-xl">
          {outOfStockTx}
        </span>
      </div>
    )}

    <!-- Low stock strip at bottom of image -->
    {!isOutOfStock && isLowStock && (
      <div class="absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 px-3 py-2.5"
        style="background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--overlay-dark), transparent)"
        aria-hidden="true">
        <p class="text-white text-xs font-black">
          <Icon name="heroicons:bolt" class="w-3 h-3 inline" /> {lowStockTx}
        </p>
      </div>
    )}
  </div>

  <!-- ── Info ── -->
  <div class="flex flex-col flex-1 p-4 gap-2.5">

    <!-- Name -->
    <p class="font-bold text-sm leading-snug line-clamp-2 flex-1" style="color: var(--clr-text)">
      {product.name}
    </p>

    <!-- Rating -->
    {product.reviewStats && product.reviewStats.reviewCount > 0 && (
      <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <div class="flex gap-px" aria-hidden="true">
          {[1,2,3,4,5].map(s => (
            <svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              fill={s <= Math.round(product.reviewStats!.avgRating) ? "var(--clr-primary)" : "none"}
              stroke="var(--clr-primary)" stroke-width="1.5"
              stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
            >
              <polygon points="12 2 15.09 8.26 22 9.27 17 14.14 18.18 21.02 12 17.77 5.82 21.02 7 14.14 2 9.27 8.91 8.26 12 2"/>
            </svg>
          ))}
        </div>
        <span class="text-[0.6875rem] font-bold leading-none" style="color: var(--clr-text-2)">
          {product.reviewStats.avgRating}
          <span class="opacity-70">({product.reviewStats.reviewCount})</span>
        </span>
      </div>
    )}

    <!-- Price row -->
    <div class="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-1.5">
      <span class="font-black text-lg leading-none" style="color: var(--clr-primary)">
        {product.price.toLocaleString("ar-DZ")}
        <span class="text-[0.625rem] font-bold ms-0.5" style="color: var(--clr-primary); opacity: 0.9">{currencySymbol}</span>
      </span>
      {hasDiscount && (
        <span class="text-xs line-through font-semibold leading-none shrink-0" style="color: var(--clr-text-2)">
          {product.compareAtPrice!.toLocaleString("ar-DZ")}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>

    <!-- CTA button -->
    <div
      class="w-full h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 font-black text-sm text-white mt-0.5 transition-all duration-200 ease-out hover:brightness-110"
      style={isOutOfStock
        ? "background: var(--clr-disabled)"
        : "background: var(--clr-primary)"}
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      {!isOutOfStock && (
        <Icon name="heroicons:shopping-bag" class="w-4 h-4" aria-hidden="true" />
      )}
      {isOutOfStock ? outOfStockTx : ctaText}
    </div>
  </div>
</a>
```

```astro
---
// ── STREAMING COMPONENT ──
// This component handles the product fetch and rendering
// Allows the parent page to stream layout/head immediately
import OrderForm from "@/theme/components/order/OrderForm.astro";
import ProductGallery from "@/theme/components/product/ProductGallery.astro";
import ProductInfo from "@/theme/components/product/ProductInfo.astro";
import ReviewsIsland from "@/theme/components/product/ReviewsIsland.astro";
import ShippingIsland from "@/theme/components/product/ShippingIsland.astro";
import { getProductJsonLd } from "@/theme/utils/seo";
import { fetchProductByHandle } from "@/core/api/client";

interface Props {
  slug: string;
  config: any;
  content: any;
  isRTL: boolean;
  fieldErrors: any;
  serverError: string | null;
}

const { slug, config, content, isRTL, fieldErrors, serverError } = Astro.props;

// Fetch product data (this component streams when ready)
const product = await fetchProductByHandle(slug);

if (!product) return Astro.redirect("/");

const cur = config.currencySymbol;
const defaultVariant = product.hasVariants
  ? (product.variants.find((v: typeof product.variants[0]) => v.isDefault) ?? product.variants[0])
  : null;
const basePrice    = defaultVariant?.price ?? product.price;
const comparePrice = defaultVariant?.compareAtPrice ?? product.compareAtPrice;
const hasDiscount  = comparePrice != null && comparePrice > basePrice;
const discountPct  = hasDiscount ? Math.round((1 - basePrice / comparePrice!) * 100) : 0;

const isOutOfStock = product.trackInventory && product.inventory === 0;
const isLowStock   = product.trackInventory && product.inventory > 0 && product.inventory <= 5;
const lowStockText = content.lowStock.replace("{n}", String(product.inventory));

const defaultVariantId = defaultVariant?.id ?? null;
const jsonLd = getProductJsonLd(product, basePrice);
---

<script type="application/ld+json" set:html={JSON.stringify(jsonLd)} />

<!-- Data bridge: server-computed values → client script -->
<div
  id="page-data"
  class="sr-only"
  data-variants={JSON.stringify(product.variants)}
  data-base-price={basePrice}
  data-compare-price={comparePrice ?? ""}
  data-cur={cur}
  data-is-rtl={isRTL ? "1" : "0"}
  data-shipping-label={content.shippingLabel}
  data-shipping-calc={content.shippingCalculated}
  data-shipping-free={content.shippingFree}
  data-total-label={content.totalLabel}
  data-commune-placeholder={content.formCommunePlaceholder}
  data-commune-loading={content.formCommuneLoading}
  data-commune-disabled={content.formCommuneDisabled}
  data-offers={JSON.stringify(product.offers)}
  data-offer-free-label={content.offerFreeLabel}
  data-offer-active={content.offerActive}
  data-offer-unlocked={content.offerUnlocked}
  data-offer-add-more={content.offerAddMore}
  data-offer-add-one={content.offerAddOne}
  data-offer-you-get={content.offerYouGet}
  data-track-inventory={product.trackInventory ? "1" : "0"}
  data-out-of-stock-label={content.outOfStock}
  data-qty-max-stock={content.qtyMaxStock}
  data-inventory={String(product.inventory)}
  data-pixel-id={config.pixelId ?? ""}
  data-phone-invalid={content.formPhoneInvalid}
  data-product-id={product.id}
  data-product-name={product.name}
/>

<!-- Dynamic data Island (Deferred) -->
<ShippingIsland server:defer />

<div class="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-0 sm:px-5 py-0 sm:py-8">
  <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-0 lg:gap-12">

    <!-- ── LEFT: Images ── -->
    <div>
      <ProductGallery
        product={product}
        hasDiscount={hasDiscount}
        discountPct={discountPct}
        isRTL={isRTL}
        content={content}
      />
      <ProductInfo
        product={product}
        basePrice={basePrice}
        comparePrice={comparePrice}
        cur={cur}
        isLowStock={isLowStock}
        lowStockText={lowStockText}
        isDesktop={true}
      />
    </div>

    <!-- ── RIGHT: Product info + Order form ── -->
    <div class="px-5 sm:px-0 py-6 sm:py-0">

      <!-- Mobile Info -->
      <ProductInfo
        product={product}
        basePrice={basePrice}
        comparePrice={comparePrice}
        cur={cur}
        isLowStock={isLowStock}
        lowStockText={lowStockText}
      />

      <OrderForm
        product={product}
        content={content}
        fieldErrors={fieldErrors}
        serverError={serverError}
        basePrice={basePrice}
        defaultVariant={defaultVariant ?? null}
        cur={cur}
        isRTL={isRTL}
        offers={product.offers}
        defaultVariantId={defaultVariantId}
        isOutOfStock={isOutOfStock}
        otpEnabled={config.otpEnabled === true}
        turnstileEnabled={config.turnstileEnabled === true}
        turnstileSiteKey={config.turnstileSiteKey ?? null}
        showCommune={config.showCommune !== false}
      />
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Reviews section (Deferred Server Island) -->
{config.reviewsEnabled && (
  <div class="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-5 pb-12">
    <ReviewsIsland productId={product.id} content={content} server:defer>
      <!-- Skeleton fallback while loading -->
      <div slot="fallback" class="animate-pulse space-y-8 mt-12 pt-10" style="border-top: 1px solid var(--clr-border)">
        <div class="h-8 rounded-lg w-1/4" style="background: var(--clr-surface-alt)"></div>
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12">
          <div class="space-y-4">
            {[1,2,3].map(() => (
              <div class="h-32 rounded-2xl" style="background: var(--clr-surface-alt); border: 1px solid var(--clr-border)"></div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div class="h-64 rounded-2xl" style="background: var(--clr-surface-alt); border: 1px solid var(--clr-border)"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </ReviewsIsland>
  </div>
)}
```

```astro
---
import { Image } from "astro:assets";
import type { Product } from "@/core/api/types";
import type { StoreFrontContent } from "@/theme/config/content";
import { Icon } from "astro-icon/components";

interface Props {
  product: Product;
  hasDiscount: boolean;
  discountPct: number;
  isRTL: boolean;
  content: StoreFrontContent;
}

const { product, hasDiscount, discountPct, isRTL, content } = Astro.props;
---

<div class="relative">
  <!-- Mobile scroll-snap gallery -->
  <div class="gallery-track sm:rounded-[2rem] aspect-square lg:aspect-[4/5]" id="gallery">
    {product.images.length > 0 ? product.images.map((img, idx) => (
      <div class="gallery-slide" data-image-id={img.id}>
        {idx === 0 ? (
          /* LCP image: priority=true → fetchpriority=high + loading=eager + decoding=sync.
             widths + sizes let the browser pick the right resolution:
             ~400 px on mobile, ~720 px on desktop (saves ~15 KiB vs always fetching 800 px). */
          <Image
            src={img.src}
            alt={img.altText ?? product.name}
            width={800}
            height={800}
            widths={[400, 720, 800]}
            sizes="(min-width: 1024px) 50vw, 100vw"
            priority={true}
            format="webp"
            quality={90}
            class="w-full h-full object-cover"
          />
        ) : (
          /* Non-visible slides: lazy so they don't compete with the LCP image. */
          <Image
            src={img.src}
            alt={img.altText ?? product.name}
            width={800}
            height={800}
            loading="lazy"
            decoding="async"
            format="webp"
            quality={90}
            class="w-full h-full object-cover"
          />
        )}
      </div>
    )) : (
      <div class="gallery-slide flex items-center justify-center" style="background: var(--clr-surface-alt)">
        <Icon name="heroicons:photo" class="w-24 h-24 opacity-20" style="color: var(--clr-text-2)" />
      </div>
    )}
  </div>

  <!-- Badges on gallery -->
  <div class="absolute top-4 start-4 flex flex-col gap-2">
    {hasDiscount && (
      <span class="bg-red-600 text-white text-xs font-black px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg shadow-md tracking-tight">
        -{discountPct}%
      </span>
    )}
  </div>

  <!-- Dots (mobile) / Thumbnails (desktop) -->
  <div class="px-5 sm:px-0 mt-4">
    {product.images.length > 1 && (
      <div class="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 sm:hidden" id="gallery-dots">
        {product.images.map((_, i) => (
          <button
            type="button"
            class="w-11 h-11 p-0 flex items-center justify-center transition-all gallery-dot"
            aria-label={content.ariaGoToImage.replace("{n}", String(i + 1)).replace("{total}", String(product.images.length))}
            data-index={i}
          >
            <span
              class:list={[
                "w-2 h-2 rounded-full transition-all",
                i === 0 ? "w-5 opacity-100" : "opacity-30",
              ]}
              style="background: var(--clr-primary)"
            />
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div class="hidden sm:flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto scrollbar-hide pb-2">
        {product.images.map((img, i) => (
          <button
            type="button"
            class:list={[
              "shrink-0 w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-2 transition-all gallery-thumb active:scale-90",
              i === 0 ? "border-[var(--clr-primary)] shadow-md" : "border-transparent opacity-60 hover:opacity-100",
            ]}
            data-index={i}
          >
            <Image
              src={img.src}
              alt={img.altText ?? `${i + 1}`}
              width={80}
              height={80}
              loading={i < 4 ? "eager" : "lazy"}
              decoding="async"
              format="webp"
              quality={80}
              class="w-full h-full object-cover"
            />
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    )}
  </div>
</div>

<style>
  .gallery-track {
    display: flex;
    overflow-x: auto;
    scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    background: var(--clr-surface);
  }
  .gallery-track::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }
  .gallery-slide {
    flex: 0 0 100%;
    scroll-snap-align: start;
    position: relative;
  }
</style>
```
